changelog.message: op created for high-performance Swift-backed native Syphon In capture
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Captures real-time global Syphon video/image streams from macOS applications using a high-performance native Swift-backed sidecar process and Metal.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable global Syphon capture listening.

ports.name: Server
ports.text: Select from the list of dynamically discovered active Syphon servers on your macOS system.

ports.name: Texture
ports.text: The output WebGL texture containing the captured frames.

ports.name: Next
ports.text: Trigger button fired when a new frame is received and uploaded to WebGL.

ports.name: Width
ports.text: Width of the captured video frame.

ports.name: Height
ports.text: Height of the captured video frame.

ports.name: Found
ports.text: True if there are active Syphon servers found on the system.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the native sidecar process is running.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the sidecar daemon.
